findings.summary: `_select_items_needing_kind` re-implements the analysis-JSON parse-with-fallback block (`if row["analysis"]: try: json.loads(...) except json.JSONDecodeError: analysis = None`) that already exists, verbatim, at six call sites in daemon/src/prismis_daemon/storage.py (get_content_by_id ~1274-1281, and five other row-mapping methods at ~1220, ~1338, ~1635, ~1759, ~1857). None of those is exposed as a reusable helper, so this is not a regression this job introduced structurally, but it is a seventh copy of the same parse-or-None logic landing in a different module (cli) rather than calling into Storage for it. Low severity: the duplication is pre-existing codebase convention, not new logic invented by this diff, and every SC is otherwise satisfied by real behavior, not by this parsing choice.
